## F — Structured research index

Open verification debts for this section: none. Every the scale of the drinking-driver problem, how alcohol acts on the body, the implied consent and administrative revocation laws, zero tolerance for drivers under twenty-one, impairment thresholds, open container rules and the effects of prescription, over-the-counter and illegal drugs claim in parts C and C-two carries a page-bound anchor, and part D raised no accuracy flag.

Exam facts recorded as unknown (question count, passing standard, time limit, format) are terminal unknown states from part A, not open debts; they need no VERIFY entry.

Market and teardown scope statements live in parts E and E-two; audience and exam-authority context live in parts B and A.

Consolidated VERIFY list: empty for this section. The interleaved words on the first page are recorded as a source-form caution in part D, not as an open debt, because the page states each figure plainly.

corpus_stability.reason: The Hawaii Driver's Manual is a periodically reprinted reference (imprint HMG 5/2023, copyright line through 2023); the the scale of the drinking-driver problem, how alcohol acts on the body, the implied consent and administrative revocation laws, zero tolerance for drivers under twenty-one, impairment thresholds, open container rules and the effects of prescription, over-the-counter and illegal drugs rules on pages 55–56 are statutory and procedural content that changes less than once a year, so no BlockedProbe.
